caption: The setup wizard opens on Connect FREE Account, with a Skip Step button to go on without a Rank Math account. Usage tracking was off by default.
After we entered the focus keyword, the free version ran its Basic SEO checks. Two failed on our short test post: the keyword in the URL and a length under 600 words.
The free Schema Generator offers 13 types such as Article, Product and Recipe. FAQ, HowTo, Dataset, Fact Check, Movie and Podcast Episode are marked PRO.
In the snippet editor we replaced the default title and description; the counters read 53 of 60 and 115 of 160 characters.
The page head Rank Math produced for our post: our description, robots, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter tags, and BlogPosting schema with our title.
Pricing on 22 Nov 2026 in the Black Friday sale: Pro at EUR 4.99 a month billed yearly for unlimited personal sites; client sites need Business or Agency.
